name: microsoft-tenant-id
title: Microsoft Tenant ID
description: Find the Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) tenant ID for a domain, email, or URL — or reverse-look up the organization behind a tenant ID.
author: Rediwed

preferences.name: clientId
preferences.title: Application (Client) ID
preferences.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the built-in multitenant Entra app registration. Paste your own Application (client) ID to use a registration you control (public client + PKCE, redirect URI https://raycast.com/redirect?packageName=Extension, scope CrossTenantInformation.ReadBasic.All).

commands.name: find-tenant-id
commands.title: Find Tenant ID
commands.description: Look up the Microsoft Entra tenant ID for a domain, email address, or URL.

commands.name: resolve-from-clipboard
commands.title: Resolve Tenant ID from Clipboard
commands.description: Resolve the tenant ID for the domain in your selection or clipboard and copy it.

commands.name: lookup-by-tenant-id
commands.title: Find Organization by Tenant ID
commands.description: Reverse lookup: find the organization name and default domain for a Microsoft tenant ID. Personal-account tenant IDs need no sign-in; organization tenants use a work or school sign-in.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
